reason: I would use the free first visit for sure and bring a couple of moms from my group. Pay-per-visit at $13 with coffee is fine for a rainy day, but I would not do the monthly unlimited when storytime and parks are free.
objection: It is a lot to pay every week when library storytime and the parks cost nothing, so it has to feel clearly special and clean, not just another play room.
would_change_my_mind: A group rate that makes it easy to bring 4+ families, and seeing the cleaning log and the capped numbers in person on the free visit.
